items.flavor: Thin, crisp fried dough with anise, broken into shards and soaked with piloncillo and cinnamon syrup.

items.name: Mexican hotcakes
items.flavor: Soft wheat cakes with browned butter, finished with cajeta, honey, or condensed milk.

items.name: Michigan cherry pancakes
items.flavor: Tart cherry against a lightly sweet buttermilk cake.

items.name: Minnesota wild rice pancakes
items.flavor: A wheat pancake with chewy, toasted grains of wild rice scattered through it.

items.name: Mofo gasy
items.flavor: Small, sweet rice cakes with a yeasted crumb and a browned top.

items.name: Molasses pancakes
items.flavor: Strong, dark molasses in a tender wheat crumb, bittersweet rather than floral.

items.name: Monjayaki
items.flavor: A loose, runny savory batter cooked on a griddle and eaten while it is still half set.

items.name: Mont lin maya
items.flavor: A pair of small rice cakes from a dimpled pan, one plain and one topped with split peas and shallot, joined together.

items.name: Moong dal cheela
items.flavor: A soft yellow-lentil pancake, bright with ginger and green chile, less nutty than a besan cheela.

items.name: Moroccan baghrir
items.flavor: Spongy semolina cakes, yeasted and sour-sweet, soaked with butter and honey.

items.name: Moroccan harcha
items.flavor: Crumbly semolina pan bread, buttery and lightly salty, with a toasted crust.

items.name: Msemen
items.flavor: Flaky, lightly salty layered flatbread with toasted semolina between the folds.

items.name: Mysore masala dosa
items.flavor: A crisp fermented dosa spread inside with red chile-garlic chutney and a line of potato masala.

items.name: Nalysnyky
items.flavor: Ukrainian crepes rolled with cheese and baked in sour cream.

items.name: Navajo frybread
items.flavor: Fried wheat dough, blistered and salty, crisp outside and soft inside.

items.name: Neer dosa
items.flavor: A soft, pale, almost translucent rice roll with a clean cereal taste and no sour ferment.

items.name: Negiyaki
items.flavor: A scallion-heavy savory pancake, sweeter and greener than cabbage okonomiyaki, with a soft wheat crumb.

items.name: Nei appam
items.flavor: A sweet, dense rice cake scented with banana, jaggery, cardamom, and ghee.

items.name: New England cornmeal cakes
items.flavor: Coarse corn and molasses against a tangy buttermilk crumb.

items.name: New Mexico blue corn hotcakes
items.flavor: Toasted blue corn in a tender buttermilk cake, nutty and a little sweet.

items.name: New Orleans calas
items.flavor: Fried rice fritters, lightly sweet, with nutmeg and a powdered-sugar coat.

items.name: New Zealand pikelets
items.flavor: Small tea-table pikelets with a golden edge, finished with butter and golden syrup.

items.name: Newfoundland toutons
items.flavor: Fried bread dough, crisp at the rim, with salt pork and a side of molasses.

items.name: Nicaraguan güirilas
items.flavor: Thick young-corn pancakes with cuajada folded in, savory and a little milky, barely sweet.

items.name: Nigerian masa
items.flavor: Mildly sour rice cakes with crisp rims and a soft, slightly sweet center.

items.name: Normandy apple crepes
items.flavor: Wheat crepes filled with apples cooked in butter, a Normandy dessert.

items.name: Norwegian lefse
items.flavor: Potato lefse, rolled thin and griddled, soft enough to fold with butter and sugar.

items.name: Oaxacan memelas
items.flavor: An elongated masa cake spread with oil, black beans, and a mild salsa, toasted at the edges.

items.name: Oladyi
items.flavor: Small thick Russian pancakes on kefir, quicker than yeasted blini.

items.name: Onion rava dosa
items.flavor: Crisp semolina lace crowded with sweet onion, green chile, and curry leaf.

items.name: Osaka okonomiyaki
items.flavor: A thick savory pancake with cabbage mixed into the batter, topped with sauce, mayonnaise, and bonito flakes.

items.name: Pajeon
items.flavor: A savory wheat pancake packed with scallion, crisp at the rim and tender in the middle.

items.name: Palak cheela
items.flavor: A green spinach and gram-flour pancake, savory with ginger and cumin, soft rather than crisp.

items.name: Paper dosa
items.flavor: A very large, very thin fermented rice sheet that shatters at the edge and tastes toasted.

items.name: Paraguayan mbeju
items.flavor: A crisp griddled cake of manioc starch, cornmeal, and cheese, salty at the edge and tender in the middle.

items.name: Parāoa parai
items.flavor: Fried wheat bread, puffed and crisp at the rim, with a soft, salty interior.

items.name: Patishapta
items.flavor: A soft rice-and-wheat crepe rolled around a coconut and jaggery filling, fragrant with cardamom.

items.name: Pennsylvania Dutch funnel cakes
items.flavor: Crisp fried batter, lightly eggy, buried under powdered sugar.

items.name: Pennsylvania Dutch potato pancakes
items.flavor: Shredded potato, onion, and pepper, crisp at the edge and soft in the middle.

items.name: Peruvian tacu-tacu
items.flavor: A pan-fried cake of leftover rice and beans, garlicky, with a crisp face and mild ají amarillo.

items.name: Pesarattu
items.flavor: A green-gold moong dal pancake, herbal from ginger and green chile, with a soft crisp edge.

items.name: Piadina
items.flavor: The griddled flatbread of Romagna. It is a flatbread, folded around a filling.

items.name: Placki ziemniaczane
items.flavor: Polish potato pancakes, shredded and fried, with sugar or sour cream.

items.name: Plain dosa
items.flavor: Crisp at the edge, faintly sour, with a toasted rice smell and a soft underside.

items.name: Poffertjes
items.flavor: Small yeast pancakes from a dimpled Dutch pan, buttered and dusted with sugar.

items.name: Pol roti
items.flavor: A griddled coconut flatbread, lightly sweet from the coconut, with onion and green chile in the dough.

items.name: Polish naleśniki
items.flavor: Thin Polish crepes with a sweet cheese filling, rolled and warmed.

items.name: Portuguese panquecas
items.flavor: Thin Portuguese crepes with orange zest, rolled with jam.

items.name: Portuguese rabanadas
items.flavor: Portuguese Christmas fried bread, soaked in milk and egg, with cinnamon sugar. Not a poured pancake.

items.name: Potato latkes
items.flavor: Ashkenazi potato pancakes for Hanukkah, fried in oil, with the older cheese custom named beside them.

items.name: Pudla
items.flavor: A turmeric-yellow Gujarati besan pancake, savory and a little sweet, eaten with chutney.

items.name: Puerto Rican almojábanas
items.flavor: Fried rice-flour and cheese fritters, crisp at the edge, salty and chewy inside.

items.name: Pumpkin pancakes
items.flavor: Soft pumpkin, cinnamon, and ginger in a lightly sweet wheat cake.

items.name: Pupusas
items.flavor: Griddled masa stuffed with beans and melting cheese, served with tangy curtido and a light tomato salsa.

items.name: Racuchy
items.flavor: Small yeasted Polish pancakes with apple, dusted with sugar.

items.name: Raggmunk
items.flavor: Crisp Swedish potato pancakes from raw grated potato, with lingonberries.

items.name: Ragi dosa
items.flavor: An earthy, malt-dark finger-millet dosa with a mild chile edge and a crisp skin.

items.name: Rava dosa
items.flavor: A lacy, cracker-crisp semolina sheet scented with cumin, black pepper, and curry leaf.

items.name: Rhode Island johnnycakes
items.flavor: Toasted corn, salt, and a crisp edge, with almost no sweetness in the cake itself.

items.name: Romanian clătite
items.flavor: Thin Romanian crepes with jam or sweet cheese, a home dessert.

items.name: Roti canai
items.flavor: A flaky, laminated wheat flatbread, griddled until the outside shatters and the inside stays stretchy.

items.name: Russian blini
items.flavor: Yeasted wheat blini for Maslenitsa, butter week, with sour cream and butter.

items.name: Samoan panikeke
items.flavor: Round fried cakes, lightly sweet, with mashed banana in a soft wheat crumb.

items.name: San Francisco sourdough pancakes
items.flavor: Tangy sourdough in a thin, buttered wheat pancake.

items.name: Saudi mutabbaq
items.flavor: A thin, pan-fried stuffed flatbread with a savory leek and egg center and a mild chile edge.

items.name: Scotch pancakes
items.flavor: Small thick drop scones from a Scottish girdle, butter and jam.

items.name: Scottish oatcakes
items.flavor: Thin, dry, unleavened oatcakes from a Scottish girdle.

items.name: Serabi
items.flavor: A small, thick coconut-rice pancake with a porous face, served with palm-sugar syrup.

items.name: Serbian palačinke
items.flavor: Thin Serbian crepes rolled with plum jam.

items.name: Set dosa
items.flavor: Thick, soft, and mildly sour, with a spongy face and a pale golden underside.

items.name: Shandong jianbing
items.flavor: A very thin, cracker-crisp crepe, torn into pieces and eaten with scallion and a savory paste.

items.name: Singaporean roti prata
items.flavor: A flaky laminated flatbread from a Singapore coffee shop, crisp at the edge and chewy inside, served with curry.

items.name: Singing hinnies
items.flavor: Currant griddle cakes from Northumberland. The fat sizzles, which is the singing.

items.name: Skillet bannock
items.flavor: Plain wheat bread, slightly salty, with a fried face and a soft center.

items.name: Slovak palačinky
items.flavor: Thin Slovak crepes rolled with cocoa and sugar, a home filling without a brand of spread.

items.name: Socca
items.flavor: A crisp-edged chickpea flatbread from Nice, eaten hot with black pepper.

items.name: Somali canjeero
items.flavor: Soft, lightly sour wheat cakes full of small holes, mildly sweet at the edge.

items.name: Sopes
items.flavor: A small thick masa base with a raised rim, topped with beans, cheese, onion, and salsa.

items.name: Souffle hotcakes
items.flavor: Extremely thick, jiggly pancakes with a browned cap and a soft, egg-white interior.

items.name: South African pannekoek
items.flavor: Thin wheat pancakes rolled around cinnamon sugar, with a buttery edge.

items.name: Southeastern corn griddle cakes
items.flavor: Plain corn, salt, and a toasted surface, with no sugar and no wheat.

items.name: Southern banana pancakes
items.flavor: Ripe banana mashed into a tangy buttermilk pancake, soft and sweet.

items.name: Southern buttermilk pancakes
items.flavor: Tangy buttermilk, a little sugar, and a soft crumb with a browned rim.

items.name: Southern hoecakes
items.flavor: Plain toasted corn, salt, and a fried edge, denser than a wheat pancake.

items.name: Spanish tortilla de patatas
items.flavor: A potato omelet. It is not a pancake. This page says so and still cooks the omelet.

items.name: Spanish tortitas
items.flavor: Small thick Spanish pancakes with lemon, a home breakfast, not a tortilla.

items.name: Spekdik
items.flavor: A thick Groningen buckwheat pancake with bacon in the batter, served with syrup.

items.name: Spring pancakes
items.flavor: Soft wheat wrappers for the start of spring, rolled around shredded vegetables and a savory-sweet sauce.

items.name: Sri Lankan coconut pancakes
items.flavor: A thin sweet crepe rolled with grated coconut and jaggery, meant for tea time.

items.name: Sri Lankan hoppers
items.flavor: A crisp-edged rice bowl with a soft coconut center and a light ferment tang.

items.name: Staffordshire oatcakes
items.flavor: Large, soft, yeasted oatmeal pancakes from the Potteries, rolled around a savory filling.

items.name: Sudanese kisra
items.flavor: Thin, tangy sorghum sheets with a flexible, faintly bitter grain taste.

items.name: Svele
items.flavor: Thick west-Norwegian pancakes, the ferry kiosk cake, with jam or brown whey cheese.

items.name: Swedish pannkakor
items.flavor: Thin Swedish pancakes, pan-cooked, served with lingonberry jam.

items.name: Swedish plättar
items.flavor: Tiny Swedish pancakes from a plätt pan, with jam and cream.

items.name: Sweet potato pancakes
items.flavor: Orange-fleshed sweet potato, a little cinnamon, and a moist wheat crumb.

items.name: Swiss rösti
items.flavor: A shredded potato cake from Switzerland, pan-fried as one round. Not a batter pancake.

items.name: Syrniki
items.flavor: Pan-fried Russian farmer-cheese cakes, with sour cream and jam.

items.name: Taiwanese danbing
items.flavor: A thin breakfast crepe with egg cooked on its face, brushed with soy sauce and rolled with scallion.

items.name: Taiwanese oyster omelet
items.flavor: A soft, starch-set omelet crowded with oysters, finished with a sweet-savory sauce and greens.

items.name: Takoyaki
items.flavor: Crisp-edged batter balls with a piece of octopus in the center, finished with sauce and bonito.

items.name: Tattie scones
items.flavor: Thin potato triangles from a Scottish girdle, eaten at breakfast.

items.name: Texas pecan pancakes
items.flavor: Buttered wheat cakes with toasted pecan, sweet and slightly bitter at the brown edge of the nut.

items.name: Thai roti
items.flavor: A stretched, griddled wheat bread, crisp and chewy, wrapped around banana and condensed milk.

items.name: Thalipeeth
items.flavor: A hearty multigrain griddle bread, onion-flecked, with toasted millet and chickpea in the crumb.

items.name: Tianjin jianbing
items.flavor: A soft savory crepe wrapped around egg, sauce, herbs, and a shatter of crisp fried dough.

items.name: Tlacoyos
items.flavor: An oval masa cake with a seam of mashed beans, topped with nopales, onion, and salsa.

items.name: Topfenpalatschinken
items.flavor: Austrian crepes filled with sweetened quark and baked until the cheese is warm.

items.name: Tortillitas de camarones
items.flavor: Crisp Cádiz fritters of tiny shrimp and chickpea flour.

items.name: Trinidadian dhalpuri roti
items.flavor: A soft wheat roti with a layer of seasoned ground split peas that flakes when the bread is clapped.

items.name: Tunisian mlawi
items.flavor: Soft, oiled, layered round with a flaky edge and a mild wheat taste.

items.name: Turkish gözleme
items.flavor: Thin stuffed flatbread, griddled, with spinach and salty white cheese in the fold.

items.name: Turkish kaygana
items.flavor: A soft flour-and-egg skillet cake, herb-flecked, with a tender center and a browned rim.

items.name: Turnip cake
items.flavor: A savory daikon cake of rice flour, steamed until set, then pan-fried so the slices crust.

items.name: Ugandan kabalagala
items.flavor: Sweet fried cakes of ripe banana and wheat flour, crisp outside and soft within.

items.name: Ulster soda farls
items.flavor: Griddled soda-bread farls from Ulster, cut in quarters.

items.name: Upper Midwest Swedish pancakes
items.flavor: Thin, eggy, and lightly sweet, rolled around butter and jam.

items.name: Uruguayan panqueques
items.flavor: Thin wheat crepes rolled with firm quince paste and a slice of fresh cheese.

items.name: Uttapam
items.flavor: A thick, soft fermented cake topped with onion, tomato, and green chile.

items.name: Venezuelan arepas
items.flavor: Thick white-corn cakes, griddled until they crackle, split and filled with fresh cheese.

items.name: Vermont maple pancakes
items.flavor: A mild wheat cake with real maple in the batter and a stronger maple pour on top.

items.name: Welsh crempog
items.flavor: Welsh buttermilk griddle cakes, stacked with butter between the layers.

items.name: Xianbing
items.flavor: A round northern wheat cake sealed around a juicy pork and scallion filling, pan-fried until spotted.

items.name: Yemeni lahoh
items.flavor: Spongy sorghum cakes, sour and earthy, with holes that hold beans or egg.

items.name: Zambian vitumbuwa
items.flavor: Sweet coconut-rice fritters with a crisp fried crust and a soft grain center.
